items.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI lays out a multi-layered defense against capability theft via distillation, spanning training, protective measures, monitoring, and enforcement.

items.title: Introducing conductor mode in Kiro Crew
items.en_title: Introducing conductor mode in Kiro Crew
items.en_oneliner: Kiro Crew's new mode lets an agent orchestrate feature work in parallel, drive a browser window directly, and show live progress and testing inside chat.

items.title: Why agent governance starts with observability
items.en_title: Why agent governance starts with observability
items.en_oneliner: LangChain argues that governing agents starts with seeing what they do: observability is the foundation of governance, not an afterthought.

items.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
items.en_title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
items.en_oneliner: Financial research platform Hebbia found GPT-6 Astra ahead of rival models on both citation accuracy and presentation quality: it scored 13.6 points above the best alternative on citing required sources, 99.5% of its citations were relevant to the question, and its decks met 97.9% of formatting requirements.

items.title: Introducing harness adapters: adapt your favorite model to your harness to improve performance and cost
items.en_title: Introducing harness adapters: adapt your favorite model to your harness to improve performance and cost
items.en_oneliner: Hugging Face trained RL-based LoRA adapters that tune Qwen3.8-27B for Pi, OpenCode, and Hermes Agent, lifting benchmark scores while cutting token use, and published the full recipe for reproducing it.

items.title: Welcome Inkling 2 Mini, Cutting-edge Performance for your Local Setup
items.en_title: Welcome Inkling 2 Mini, Cutting-edge Performance for your Local Setup
items.en_oneliner: Thinking Machines Lab has released Inkling 2 Mini, a looped-transformer mixture-of-experts model with roughly 26B parameters and only 3B active per token, offering a 1M-token context and image-plus-text input for local setups, with measured performance rivaling Qwen3.8-27B.

items.title: Can AI help scientists identify promising drug candidates?
items.en_title: Can AI help scientists identify promising drug candidates?
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI introduces MedChemBench, a benchmark that probes whether AI models can read molecular structures, weigh experimental evidence, and shortlist promising compounds for early drug discovery.
Version 2.1.329 adds two safety prompts for hook configuration: the dialog now shows which folder a hook is declared in, and non-interactive hosts also flag hooks from managed settings.

items.title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
items.en_title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
items.en_oneliner: Google has added Tool Retrieval to the Gemini API in preview, letting agents keep a large tool library on standby and load parameter schemas only when needed, cutting input tokens while keeping tool selection accurate.

items.title: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.
items.en_title: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.
items.en_oneliner: Biographer Walter Isaacson joins Google to reflect on lessons from history's great innovators for staying creative and exercising judgment as AI advances.
